notes.title: BIG UPDATE!
notes.content:
Hello my frogs
In celebration of 1 year of sokofrog development and more than 1000 units sold
I want to celebrate with this big update
adding
- 50 new stages with new mechanics
- 3 new skins for your little frogs
- Full control support

Bug Fix:
- Menu crash bug fixed
- fixed some collision bugs in the beach scene

Thank you so much for all your support and I hope everyone has fun 🐸

notes.title: UPDATE!
notes.content:
Updates that took place between 12/15/2022 to 1/15/2023 fixed the following issues:

[list]
[*] Fullscreen and Screenshake now save when closing the game.
[*] Collision issue on levels 17, 23 and 66 has been fixed.
[*] Animation of falling bomb has been fixed.
[/list]

Thank you all for your patience 🐸.
